Weltall (Unofficial Xenogears Unreal Engine PC Port) Hello all. I've been working on Weltall, a native port of Xenogears built in Unreal Engine 5. It's at a point where I'm comfortable making it public. The whole game should be fully playable (my own play through is about 16 hours in so far with no issues). Aside from being fully accurate to the original game's gameplay, here are some of the new features: Widescreen up to 32:9 at any resolution, High refresh rates (120+), Right analog stick/mouse controlled camera, Graphics improvements that don't rely on AI upscaling, The Gears' 3D battle models used for walking around on the world map and in dungeons, Text speed up to 2x/4x/Instant, and battle speed 2x or 4x with R1, automatically goes back to 1x for event/boss battles...

Just completed White Knight Chronicles for the first time And I quite enjoyed it. I was shocked I enjoyed it as much as I did. I played the international version because I like playing games in their original form first which is why I passed on the White Knight Chronicles II version that came with the first game. I did the same with Yakuza 3 earlier this year. I went with the original PS3 version. Sure, it's nowhere near a masterpiece but it was good enough for me to play all the way through without feeling like a chore. I even liked the slow battle system that seems to be a main complaint. I guess I like slow battle systems cause Suikoden III is my favorite JRPG of all time and that also gets flack for it's slow and clunky battle system.
